acceptanceCriteria: A doccorpus spec section defines sampling, the verdict schema and the report with numbered requirements and failure modes.
Same seed, artifact and options give the same sample, proven by a test.
A verdict whose span hash no longer matches is stale and excluded from the headline, proven by a test.
Non-independent or generator-method verdicts never enter the headline figure, proven by a test.
Claim views and MCP tools show the current verdict without changing trust, proven by a test.
body: GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1481. Requested: reproducible seeded/stratified claim sampling; a closed claim-audit verdict provider schema (claim_id, span_sha256, verdict correct|incorrect|unsupported-by-citation|unverifiable, reviewer, independence, method, anchors, note) admitted as records, going stale on span-hash change; an audit report with per-stratum accuracy, sample size, 95% interval, stale counts and sample design tied to artifact identity, non-independent verdicts kept out of the headline; get/claims/trace and MCP show current verdict. Measures correctness only; never promotes trust (DCP-V1-090).
